Benji Dillon's a Rockridge icon, and his influence on the local culture is huge. I've seen it firsthand - people around here still talk about his games, his style. He's one of us, you know? The neighborhood loves him, and he loves it back. I've had conversations with him about the community, and he's always been passionate about giving back.
